+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+
+
+out = Path("out")
+values = duckdb.sql(
+    """
+    SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM crash_date)::INT AS year,
+           SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed)::BIGINT AS pedestrians_killed
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).df()
+expected = list(range(2013, 2026))
+assert values["year"].tolist() == expected, values.to_string(index=False)
+assert values["pedestrians_killed"].notna().all()
+
+values.to_csv(out / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+values.to_csv(out / "values_2.csv", index=False)
+plt.rcParams.update(
+    {"font.size": 10, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False}
+)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.4), constrained_layout=True)
+bars = ax.bar(
+    values["year"].astype(str), values["pedestrians_killed"],
+    color="#2369a1", width=0.72
+)
+ax.bar_label(bars, padding=3, fontsize=9)
+ax.set_title(
+    "Pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes, 2013–2025",
+    loc="left", fontsize=14, weight="bold", pad=14,
+)
+ax.set_xlabel("Crash year")
+ax.set_ylabel("Pedestrians killed (count)")
+ax.set_ylim(0, 190)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+fig.savefig(out / "option_1.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.4), constrained_layout=True)
+ax.plot(
+    values["year"], values["pedestrians_killed"], color="#b24b35",
+    marker="o", linewidth=2.3, markersize=6,
+)
+for year, count in zip(values["year"], values["pedestrians_killed"]):
+    ax.annotate(
+        str(count), (year, count), xytext=(0, 8),
+        textcoords="offset points", ha="center", fontsize=8,
+    )
+ax.set_title(
+    "Annual pedestrian deaths in NYC crashes, 2013–2025",
+    loc="left", fontsize=14, weight="bold", pad=14,
+)
+ax.set_xlabel("Crash year")
+ax.set_ylabel("Pedestrians killed (count)")
+ax.set_xticks(expected)
+ax.set_xticklabels(expected, rotation=45, ha="right")
+ax.set_ylim(0, 190)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+fig.savefig(out / "option_2.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+print(values.to_string(index=False))
*** End Patch
